Rules: - registerReferrer(referrer) once per wallet, permanent, before first purchase.   Self-referral allowed; loop-safe because we only walk 2 levels. - Level 1 default 2000 bps (20%), level 2 default 1000 bps (10%) (via FeeConfig, 48h timelock,   hard caps 3000 / 1500). - Commission is paid from the platform receipt; buyer price never changes. - In the same tx the registry calls creditCommission(buyer, price, isCityPurchase).   Vault computes level1/level2 shares, credits unclaimed[], transfers the sum from   msg.sender (the registry must have approved the vault for the amount before calling). - Total commission never exceeds price (enforced). - A missing level's share goes to Treasury. - No hold: referrers call claim() (nonReentrant pull). - Vault balance must cover all unclaimed at all times (invariant: checked in creditCommission). - Switches: globalEnabled, citiesEnabled, districtsEnabled (all default ON).   countryOff[] and claimCountryBlocklist[] are owner-managed sets (default empty = none off). acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

params.referrer: The wallet that referred msg.sender. May be msg.sender (self) or zero                 (no referrer — goes to Treasury at both levels).

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

creditCommission(address,uint256,bool,st.notice: Credit commissions for a license purchase.         The calling registry must have already transferred `price` USDC to itself         and must approve this vault for `commissionTotal` before calling.         Returns the total commission pulled (may be 0 if disabled).

registerReferrer(address).notice: Register a referrer for msg.sender. One-time, permanent.
